parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: lsr-id
parameters.explanation: MPLS的LSR ID，用于标识MPLS网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls label protocol ldp.command: set protocols mpls label protocol ldp

set protocols ospf area 0 interface Giga.template: set protocols ospf area [parameter1] interface [parameter2] encap [parameter3] [parameter4] tunnel-mtu [parameter5] mtu-ignore
set protocols ospf area 0 interface Giga.command: set protocols ospf area 0 interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0.1 encap dot1q 10 tunnel-mtu 5784 mtu-ignore
set protocols ospf area 0 interface Giga.explanation: 配置OSPF区域接口的封装类型、隧道MTU及MTU忽略。

set forwarding l2vpn forwarder vsi a2 tu.template: set forwarding l2vpn forwarder vsi [parameter1] tunnels [parameter2] neighbor [parameter3] policy [parameter4]
set forwarding l2vpn forwarder vsi a2 tu.command: set forwarding l2vpn forwarder vsi a2 tunnels p2p-lsp neighbor 3.3.3.9 policy policy1
set forwarding l2vpn forwarder vsi a2 tu.explanation: 配置L2VPN转发器的VSI、隧道类型、邻居及策略。

set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0..template: set forwarding l2fib interface [parameter1] tunnel-id vsi [parameter2] explicit-name [parameter3] next-hop [parameter4]
set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0..command: set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0.0 tunnel-id vsi a2 explicit-name path2pe2 next-hop 16300
set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0..explanation: 配置L2FIB接口的隧道ID、VSI、显式名称及下一跳。

set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0..template: set forwarding l2fib interface [parameter1] tunnel-id vsi [parameter2] explicit-name [parameter3] next-hop [parameter4]
set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0..command: set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0.0 tunnel-id vsi a2 explicit-name path2pe2 next-hop 16200
set forwarding l2fib interface ge-0/0/0..explanation: 配置L2FIB接口的隧道ID、VSI、显式名称及下一跳。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 encapsula.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] encapsulation [parameter3] [parameter4] family ipv4 address [parameter5]/[parameter6]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 encapsula.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 encapsulation dot1q 10 family ipv4 address 10.10.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 encapsula.explanation: 配置接口的封装类型、VLAN ID及IPv4地址。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.9/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options static route 10.10.1.template: set routing-options static route [parameter1]/[parameter2] next-hop interface [parameter3]
set routing-options static route 10.10.1.command: set routing-options static route 10.10.1.0/24 next-hop interface ge-0/0/0.0
set routing-options static route 10.10.1.explanation: 配置静态路由的下一跳接口。
